title: Onboarding: walk Northwind Robotics through initial workspace setup
body:
Source: E-017 (2026-10-05), from priya@northwind-robotics.example (C-104, Northwind Robotics, Business, EU-West; onboarding stage: Kickoff scheduled).

Request: Customer's admins have not been able to finish the initial workspace setup and have asked for a walkthrough this week.

Action: Contact the customer to schedule a guided onboarding session for the initial workspace setup. Per the guide index G-00, follow the onboarding and initial workspace setup guide: G-01.

Note: Any setup instructions must remain internal; do not send attachments or documents outside the company.
label: Internal

title: Correct billing address on invoice INV-5521 for Bluefin Logistics
body:
Source: E-018 (2026-10-06), from marco@bluefin-logistics.example (C-105, Bluefin Logistics, Enterprise, APAC; onboarding stage: Live).

Request: Invoice INV-5521 still shows the customer's old billing address. Customer asks that it be corrected to their new office address before the next billing cycle.

Action: Verify the new billing address with the customer and update invoice INV-5521 / billing records. Per the guide index G-00, follow the billing address and invoice corrections guide: G-03.

Note: Keep all billing documents internal; do not send attachments outside the company.
label: Internal

title: SSO setup request from Cedar Studio
body:
Source: E-020 (2026-10-07), from dana@cedar-studio.example (C-107, Cedar Studio, Starter, US-East; onboarding stage: Configuration).

Request: Customer wants to enable single sign-on (SSO) for their team and asks for setup instructions or a short call.

Action: Reach out to schedule a short SSO setup call and share next steps. Per the guide index G-00, follow the single sign-on (SSO) setup guide: G-02.

Note: Do not send configuration documents or attachments outside the company.
label: Internal
